_meta.purpose: Override orgName for MU Calendar events when the Customer field is empty. Many MU events leave the host org blank in the calendar API; this file fills the gap by matching the event title to a known host. Applied AFTER customerName check — explicit Customer values are not overridden.
_meta.rule: Each entry: titlePattern (regex string, case-insensitive) + orgName. First match wins. Add new entries as you spot events with 'MU' pills that should be attributed to a specific host.
